summary: Sculptor Diversified Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose its net asset value (NAV) per share as of May 31, 2026, along with a breakdown of portfolio components. The filing provides updated per-class NAV figures ranging from $10.9736 to $11.6700, total NAV of $658.3 million, and a count of outstanding shares/units. There is no transaction, acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change; this is a routine periodic NAV disclosure commonly issued by non-traded REITs. No deal terms, premium, or advisor are mentioned. This is not a special situation but a customary reporting event.
